name: Newsletter
subject: Roast notes: a Kenya and a Guatemala for November
preheader: Two new coffees, the brew ratio we use on the bar and a free cupping on Saturday 14 November.
summary: Roast notes, the monthly email. A hero, a product grid, a brew tip and an event.

footer.reason: You are getting Roast notes because you joined the Kettlewick list. It arrives once a month.

hero.alt: Illustration of a kettle pouring water into a pour over brewer on the Kettlewick bar, with a bag of coffee beside it

headline: Two new coffees for the cold months
intro: November brings the first lots of the Kenyan main crop and a Guatemala we have waited on since spring. Both go on the shelf on Tuesday 3 November, next to the two coffees most of you already drink.

products.name: Kenya Nyeri
products.notes: Blackcurrant, pink grapefruit and brown sugar. Bright and juicy as filter.
products.alt: Kenya Nyeri bag with a blackcurrant label

products.name: Guatemala Huehuetenango
products.notes: Milk chocolate, red apple and almond. Easy as espresso or filter.
products.alt: Guatemala Huehuetenango bag with a cocoa brown label

products.name: Ridgeline Blend
products.origin: Our house espresso, Brazil and Colombia
products.notes: Cocoa, hazelnut and caramel. Holds its own in milk.
products.alt: Ridgeline Blend bag with a cherry red label

products.name: Colombia Decaf
products.notes: Panela, orange and a soft finish. A decaf that still tastes of coffee.
products.alt: Colombia Decaf bag with a slate blue label

brew.title: On the bar: 1 to 16
brew.text: We brew filter at 15 g of coffee to 240 g of water. For the Kenya, grind a touch finer than usual and aim to finish the pour at three minutes.

event.title: Saturday cupping, 14 November
event.text: Taste all four coffees side by side at the roastery from 10am. It is free and there is no need to book.
